ctl.usage:
Usage: vrcinema ctl [options] <command>

Commands:
  status                      what is on air, the pause, the queue
  queue list                  the video on air and the queue
  queue add <url>             add a video or a playlist
  queue remove <id>           remove a video (its number in queue list)
  queue clear                 empty the queue (the video on air keeps playing)
  skip                        skip to the next video
  pause | resume              pause or resume the video on air
  seek <time>                 90, 1:30 or 1:02:03 from the start; +10 or -10 from here
  play-now <id>               play a queued or earlier video now
  settings get [key]          the settings ctl can change
  settings set <key> <value>  change one of them

Options:
  --json             the program’s answer as JSON
  --data-dir <dir>   the data folder of the running program
  --url <address>    the program’s address (default: from its data folder)
  --allow-remote     allow an address on another computer (password only)
  --password-stdin   read the admin password from standard input

The program on this computer is found through ctl.json in its data folder; otherwise ADMIN_PASSWORD (environment or .env) signs in.
Exit codes: 0 done, 1 refused by the program, 2 wrong usage, 3 program not found, 4 not authorized.

permalink.delete_confirm: Delete the permanent link? The tunnel is removed from your Cloudflare account, and the certificate and credentials from this computer. If the DNS record of this name stays on the account, delete it by hand in the Cloudflare dashboard.

permalink.done: Done. The channel now has a permanent address: https://{host}

permalink.login_link_lead: If the page did not open:
permalink.mode_named: Permanent link: https://{host}. The address does not change.
permalink.mode_quick: Quick link: the address is random (trycloudflare.com) and changes every time the program starts.
permalink.step_host: Step 2 of 2. Enter the full address under which the channel should work. The domain must be on your Cloudflare account.
permalink.step_login: Step 1 of 2. I will open the Cloudflare page where you log in and choose the domain for the channel.
permalink.step_login_wait: Step 1 of 2. Log in to Cloudflare and choose the domain in the browser window that opened. You have 5 minutes.
permalink.window_only: Setting up and deleting the permanent link is done in the program on the computer (it needs the Cloudflare login).
player.copy_link_label: Copy the channel link for the VRChat video player
player.label: Playback

player.pause_pending: Pause pending — On air stops at the end of this segment

preview.label: On air: the channel as the viewers get it
preview.seek_bubble: Viewers will see this in about {seconds} s
preview.seek_bubble_unknown: Viewers will see this in a few seconds
preview.sync_hint: Puts the Preview where the channel is now; the viewers see no change (key S).

queue.also_block: Also block the device (its new requests are refused)
queue.approve_list_label: Approve all videos of this list

queue.clear_body.one: {count} waiting video will be removed from the queue.
queue.clear_body.other: {count} waiting videos will be removed from the queue.

queue.drop_hint: Tip: drag video files from your computer onto this window to add them.
queue.empty: The queue is empty. Paste a link to add a video.
queue.obs_waits: OBS is on air; the queue waits until it stops.
queue.include_on_air: Also stop the video on air (“{title}”)
queue.paste_not_link: The clipboard does not hold a link (http or https).
queue.reject_list_label: Reject all videos of this list

queue.remove_requester_body.one: {count} waiting video of this viewer will be removed from the queue.
queue.remove_requester_body.other: {count} waiting videos of this viewer will be removed from the queue.

queue.remove_requester_title: Remove the videos of this viewer?
queue.reorder_hint: Drag to change the order. With the keyboard: Alt and the up or down arrow.
queue.starts_at_hint: Starts at this time; until then the stream shows a countdown.
queue.title: Up next
queue.trimmed_hint: Plays from the start point to the end point only.
queue.undo_hint: You can undo this for a few seconds.
queue.unknown_length: Total length of the known ones
settings.about.installed: Version {version} is installed. The program restarts…
settings.about.latest: You have the latest version ({version}). If there is no internet or the repository is private, the program shows nothing: the details are in the log.
settings.advanced.cookies_cleared: The cookies file is no longer used.
settings.advanced.cookies_hint: For videos that need a login.
settings.advanced.cookies_picking: Choose the file in the window that opened…
settings.advanced.pixeldrain_hint: Helps with files that have a download limit.
settings.advanced.pixeldrain_placeholder: •••• saved — type a new key to replace it
settings.advanced.broadcast_hint: These options apply from the next video (or after a seek or a pause); the video on air is not restarted.
settings.advanced.transitions_hint: Each video fades in from black and fades out at its end, picture and sound. Every video is then converted.
settings.advanced.peak_hint: The highest bitrate of a converted picture (0: automatic, 6 Mbit/s) and the encoder's buffer in seconds. A lower limit helps viewers with a slow connection; copied videos keep their own bitrate.
settings.advanced.subtitles_hint: Subtitles fetched by yt-dlp are drawn into the picture (the video's own, else automatic captions). Videos without subtitles in this language, files from disk and live streams air without them.
settings.advanced.subtitles_language_inv: Enter a language code such as en, pl or pt-BR.
settings.advanced.loudness_hint: Evens out the loudness of videos to the target level (boost at most +12 dB, peaks limited to −1.5 dB). Off by default.
settings.advanced.max_height_hint: The highest picture height the channel sends; a taller video is converted. Automatic: 1080p (720p for converted videos on a computer without a hardware encoder, such as a Raspberry Pi 5).
settings.advanced.light_profile_note: This computer converts on its processor, without a hardware encoder (for example a Raspberry Pi 5). Keep the resolution at 720p or lower: converting 1080p may fall behind. The automatic bitrate here is 3 Mbit/s.
settings.advanced.alarms_hint: The program checks each video segment on air and shows a warning at the top of the window when the picture stays black or the sound silent for the set time. This uses some processor time.
settings.advanced.saved: Saved. It applies from the next video.
settings.advanced.journal_hint: What aired and when (the newest 20 here; an export holds up to 5000). Times are when the server sent the video; viewers see it a few seconds later.
settings.advanced.journal_clear_confirm: Clear the whole broadcast journal? This cannot be undone.
settings.channel.allowed_empty_warning: The list of allowed sites is empty, so every link from viewers will be refused.
settings.channel.allowed_hint: Used in the "only allowed sites" mode. A site includes its subdomains.
settings.channel.blocked_empty_warning: The list of blocked sites is empty, so nothing is blocked: links from any site are accepted.
settings.channel.blocked_hint: Used in the "all except blocked" mode. A site includes its subdomains.
settings.channel.discontinuity: Mark transitions between videos in the stream
settings.channel.discontinuity_hint: Adds the EXT-X-DISCONTINUITY tag; most players need it.
settings.channel.domain_add_label: Add a site to the list: {list}
settings.channel.domain_invalid: "{text}" is not a site address (for example youtube.com).
settings.channel.force_transcode_hint: Slower, but the stream is more uniform.
settings.channel.force_transcode_off: Videos are converted only when needed.
settings.channel.home_network: Whatever the mode, links to the home network or to this computer are always refused.
settings.channel.limits_invalid: Every limit must be a whole number, at least 1.
settings.channel.links_hint: Which links viewers may send. Your own links are never limited.
settings.channel.max_active: Videos in the queue per person
settings.channel.mode_all_hint: Viewers can send a link from any site.
settings.channel.mode_allowlist_hint: Only the sites on the allowed list.
settings.channel.mode_blocklist_hint: Every site except those on the blocked list.
settings.channel.moderation: Approve viewers' requests before they join the queue
settings.channel.moderation_hint: Requests then wait in "Pending approval" on the Channel view.
settings.channel.moderation_off: Requests join the queue at once.
settings.channel.moderation_on: Requests will wait for your approval.
settings.channel.slate_language_hint: The language of the screens on the stream and of the info ticker.
settings.channel.slate_language_saved_re: Language of the slates saved. The video on air starts again from where it is.
settings.channel.upload_hint: Your internet upload speed (from a speed test; 0: not given). When viewers × the stream's bitrate comes close to it, the program warns at the top. Nobody is ever refused.
settings.channel.upload_invalid: Enter a number of Mbit/s (0 or more).
settings.channel.slates_hint: The screens the stream shows when no video plays.
settings.channel.slate_frame_hint: Shown behind the pause, buffering, “Technical problem” and “Be right back” slates and the countdown.
settings.channel.slate_frame_saved: Saved. The slates are being made again.
settings.channel.slate_bg_hint: An image, GIF or short video behind “No videos in the queue” and the countdown.
settings.channel.slate_bg_limits: Up to {mb} MB; a GIF or video up to {seconds} s, without its sound.
settings.channel.slate_bg_preview: Preview of the slate with your background
settings.channel.slate_bg_saved: Background saved. The slates are being made again.
settings.channel.slate_bg_all_hint: Also behind the pause, buffering, “Technical problem” and “Be right back” slates when no last frame shows.
settings.channel.slate_bg_all_on: The background shows behind all slates.
settings.channel.slate_bg_all_off: The background shows only behind “No videos in the queue” and the countdown.
settings.channel.osc_block_hint: Shows the video on air in your VRChat chatbox through OSC. It reaches VRChat only when this program runs on the PC with VRChat (or the address below is that PC) and OSC is on in VRChat: Action Menu → Options → OSC → Enabled.
settings.channel.osc_enabled: Show the video in the chatbox
settings.channel.osc_enabled_hint: Sent when the video changes, at most one message every 1.5 s; VRChat shows up to 144 characters.
settings.channel.osc_on: The chatbox shows the video on air.
settings.channel.osc_off: The chatbox is no longer updated.
settings.channel.osc_target_invalid: Enter an IP address or a host name and a port from 1 to 65535.
settings.channel.osc_template_hint: {title}: the video’s title, {nick}: the viewer who added it, {added}: “added by …” in the language of the slates. Empty: the default text.
settings.channel.osc_repeat_hint: VRChat hides the chatbox after a while; the text can be sent again.
settings.general.autostart_hint: The program starts minimized in the tray when you sign in.
settings.general.autostart_off: The program will no longer start with Windows.
settings.general.autostart_on: The program will start with Windows.
settings.general.lan: Allow opening the page from other devices on the home network
settings.general.lan_hint: Changing this restarts the server for a moment.
settings.general.lan_off: The page is available only on this computer.
settings.general.lan_on: Other devices on the home network can now open the page.
settings.general.language_env: This server has no window: set the language with LANGUAGE in the .env file.
settings.general.language_hint: The language of the program: the interface, the tray menu and the log.
settings.general.panel_language_hint: Kept in this browser only; the program's own language does not change.
settings.general.port_hint: A new port or network access restarts the server: the video on air is interrupted for a moment and the channel link gets the new port.
settings.general.port_restarted: The server restarted on port {port}. The window moves to the new address and the channel link has this port now.
settings.general.port_same: This is already the current port.
settings.general.sign_out_hint: Ends the session of this panel in this browser.
settings.general.wizard_hint: Go through the main options again, step by step.
settings.internet.connection_ended: Done — the connection of this panel ended with it. Open the panel again at the new address or from the home network.
settings.internet.lose_access: You opened this panel through the tunnel. Switching it off ends this connection: you will lose access to this panel. When the tunnel is switched on again, a quick link gets a new address.
settings.internet.lose_access_mode: You opened this panel through the tunnel. Switching between the quick and the permanent link changes the channel's address: you will lose access to this panel at this address.
settings.internet.lose_access_reconnect: You opened this panel through the tunnel. Reconnecting ends this connection, and a quick link gets a new address: you may lose access to this panel at this address.
settings.internet.manual_hint: With the tunnel off, you can type the address under which the channel is reachable (for example from another tunnel).
settings.internet.pause_loss: Pause when the internet is gone
settings.internet.pause_loss_off: The channel will not pause when the internet is gone.
settings.internet.pause_loss_on: The channel will pause when the internet is gone.
settings.internet.pause_viewers_off: The channel will not pause when nobody is watching.
settings.internet.pause_viewers_on: The channel will pause when nobody is watching.
settings.internet.pauses_hint: A paused video resumes from the same place. Live streams are not paused.
settings.internet.trust_hint: Needed when the channel runs behind Cloudflare and should see the real addresses of viewers.
settings.internet.trust_on: Viewer addresses will be taken from Cloudflare headers.
settings.internet.tunnel: Share the channel on the internet (built-in Cloudflare tunnel)
settings.internet.tunnel_hint: The program connects to the internet by itself and gives the ready channel address for VRChat. When off, the channel works only on this computer (or at the address typed by hand).
settings.internet.tunnel_off: The tunnel is off. The channel works only locally or at the address typed by hand.
settings.internet.tunnel_on: The tunnel is on — connecting to the internet.
settings.internet.via_tunnel: This panel is open through the tunnel.
settings.log.label: Latest entries of the log
settings.nicks.reset_pin_body: The nick {nick} loses its PIN and recovery code, and all its other devices are signed out. The device that used it last keeps it without a PIN.
settings.obs.intro: Stream from OBS Studio into the channel. In OBS: Settings → Stream → Service “Custom…”, then copy the server and the stream key below.
settings.obs.server_lan_hint: For OBS on another computer of your home network.
settings.obs.key_hint: Keep it secret: whoever has it can stream to your channel.
settings.obs.new_key_hint: The old key stops working at once; enter the new one in OBS.
settings.obs.new_key_done: New key made. Enter it in OBS.
settings.obs.lan: Allow OBS from other devices on the network
settings.obs.lan_hint: Off: only OBS on this computer. On: also other devices on your home network; Windows may ask to let VRCinema through the firewall: allow it for private networks. The OBS port is never reachable through the tunnel.
settings.obs.lan_on: OBS can now connect from other devices on the home network.
settings.obs.lan_off: Only OBS on this computer can connect.
settings.obs.priority: OBS has priority over the queue
settings.obs.priority_hint: On: when OBS starts streaming, the video on air pauses where it is and OBS goes on air at once; the video goes on from the same point when OBS stops. Off: OBS waits until the video on air ends.
settings.obs.priority_on: OBS goes on air as soon as it streams.
settings.obs.priority_off: OBS waits for the video on air to end.
settings.obs.status_off: The OBS input is not running (the channel is not running).
settings.obs.status_failed: The OBS port could not be opened: {error}
settings.nav.label: Settings sections
settings.nicks.block_body: Requests from the device that holds the nick {nick} will be refused. You can lift the block here at any time.
settings.nicks.empty: No viewer has taken a nick yet.
settings.nicks.hint: The nicks viewers have used recently, with their icon. Release a nick to let someone else take it; block a device to refuse its requests.
settings.nicks.title: Viewer nicks
settings.remote.changed: The password was changed. Remote sessions signed in earlier have ended.
settings.remote.enable: Allow logging in to the panel with a password from other devices (for example through the public address)
settings.remote.enable_hint: The window of this program needs no password. The password only protects remote access.
settings.remote.password_first: First set a password (at least {min} characters). The remote panel turns on with it.
settings.remote.set_and_on: The password is set and the remote panel is on.
settings.restarting: The server is restarting. The change will be checked in a moment.
settings.ticker.enabled_hint: The title of the video and who added it.
settings.ticker.enabled_off_restart: The info ticker is off. The video on air starts again from where it is.
settings.ticker.enabled_on: The info ticker is on. The video on air starts again from where it is.
settings.ticker.encoder_cpu_note: With the info ticker the computer may not keep up. A graphics card works better (Settings → Tools).
settings.ticker.encoder_gpu_note: The info ticker will not load the computer much.
settings.ticker.hint: Burned into the picture of the stream — everyone in VRChat sees it. Needs every video to be converted.
settings.ticker.interval_hint: How often the band appears (in the "from time to time" mode)
settings.ticker.messages_hint: Shown in the band after the information about the video, one at a time — the next one each time the band appears. Up to {max}. Not translated.
settings.ticker.mode_hint: From time to time, or all the time in a loop
settings.ticker.progress_hint: A thin line at the bottom of the picture
settings.ticker.qr: QR code of the request page
settings.ticker.qr_hint: In the corner of the picture, above the band
settings.ticker.restart_note: Changing the switch, mode, interval, speed, QR code or progress line starts the video on air again from where it is (a live stream: from the next item). The texts and "next video" change at once.
settings.ticker.saved_restart: Info ticker settings saved. The video on air starts again from where it is.
settings.ticker.show_address: Show the address of the request page
settings.ticker.slow: The computer cannot keep up with the info ticker — turn it off or turn on conversion on the graphics card.
settings.ticker.speed_hint: It decides how long the text stays on the screen (now about {seconds} s)
settings.ticker.title: Info ticker
settings.ticker.too_long: A message can have at most {max} characters.
settings.ticker.too_many: There can be at most {max} messages.
settings.tools.channel_down: The channel did not start although the tools are downloaded — they may be damaged.
settings.tools.detecting: Checking the graphics card. It takes a few seconds…
settings.tools.encoder_hint: A graphics card converts without loading the processor.
settings.tools.hint: The channel needs these programs. The program downloads and checks them.
settings.tools.missing_running: Tools are missing: {tools}. The channel is on air, but some functions do not work.
settings.tools.missing_stopped: Tools are missing, so the channel is not on air.
settings.tools.no_test: The card has not been tested yet.
settings.tools.vaapi_device_hint: The graphics card’s render node. Empty: /dev/dri/renderD128. The server without a window reads VAAPI_DEVICE.
settings.tools.vaapi_device_invalid: Enter an absolute path such as /dev/dri/renderD128, or leave it empty.
settings.tools.vaapi_device_saved: The VA-API device is saved. It applies from the next video.
settings.tools.title: Programs
share.channel_hint: Paste it into the video player in VRChat (e.g. ProTV).
share.qr_alt: QR code of the request page {url}
share.qr_none: There is no public address yet. The code appears when the channel is online.
share.qr_note: On the channel's slate this code is shown when nothing is playing.
share.reconnected: The tunnel was restarted. A quick link gets a new address.
share.request_hint: Viewers add videos here. The same address is in the QR code on the channel's slate.
share.sub: The link for the VRChat player and the page where viewers add videos.
share.title: Share
share.tunnel_off: The tunnel is off, so the channel works only locally or at the address set in Settings → Internet.
shortcuts.intro: They work when the cursor is not in a text field.
shortcuts.paste: Add a link from the clipboard
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
slates.buffering_subtitle: The video is about to start
slates.fallback_subtitle: We'll be back in a moment
slates.idle_hint: Add a video on the request page
slates.brb_subtitle: The live stream continues in a moment
stats.title: Stats for nerds
titlebar.failed: The title bar could not control the window: {error}
tray.hidden_text: VRCinema keeps running in the background — the channel is still on air.
tunnel.fetching: Downloading cloudflared — the tunnel connects by itself once it is downloaded.
tunnel.named_fallback: The permanent link files are missing — the quick tunnel runs (its address changes at every start). Set up the permanent link again.
tunnel.rate_limited: Cloudflare is temporarily refusing new quick tunnels (too many attempts). Retrying in {seconds} s.
tunnel.updating: cloudflared is being updated — the tunnel will be back in a moment.
ui.no_answer: The program does not answer. Check that VRCinema is running.
ui.window_only: Available in the program on the computer
viewer.hint_any: Paste a link to a video.
viewer.howto_no_seek: Seeking in the player does not work, because this is a live channel.
viewer.howto_paste: Paste this link into the video player in the world:
viewer.howto_same_moment: Everyone sees the same moment of the video. Whoever joins later jumps into the video that is already playing.
viewer.howto_untrusted: Everyone in the instance must turn on Allow Untrusted URLs in VRChat (Settings, Comfort & Safety tab), or they will see a black screen. In Public and Group Public instances VRChat may block this address even with that option on (the world decides which sites play there); if the screen stays black, try a Friends or Invite instance.
viewer.limit: A video can be up to {limit} long.
viewer.link_placeholder: Paste a link to a video…
viewer.moderation: The channel owner approves requests before they are played.
viewer.nick_hint: Optional. Shown next to the videos added with it.
viewer.offline: Cannot reach the channel. Trying again…
viewer.pin_adopted: Your nick “{nick}” works on this device now.
viewer.pin_code_text: Save it somewhere safe: it is shown only once. With it you can get your nick back if you forget the PIN.
viewer.pin_hint: 4–8 digits, or a passphrase of 8+ characters.
viewer.pin_intro: With a PIN your nick stays yours when the channel’s address changes or you use another device.
viewer.pin_its_mine: It’s my nick: enter the PIN
viewer.pin_saved: PIN saved. Your nick “{nick}” is protected.
viewer.pin_toggle: Keep your nick with a PIN
viewer.pin_use_recovery: I forgot my PIN (use the recovery code)
viewer.send_failed: Could not send the request. Check the connection and try again.
viewer.pending: “{title}” is waiting for the channel owner's approval.
viewer.queue_empty: The queue is empty. Add the first video.
viewer.sites_none: No sites are allowed on this channel right now.
viewer.title: Video channel
wizard.encoder_cpu: No supported card was found, so the processor converts the picture. The channel will work, it only loads the computer more.
wizard.encoder_gpu: The graphics card will convert the picture.
wizard.encoder_intro: Converting the picture on the graphics card is much lighter for the computer than on the processor. I am checking what can be used.
wizard.encoder_testing: Checking the graphics card. It takes a few seconds…
wizard.language_hint: The language of the program: the interface, the tray menu and the log. You can change it later in Settings.
wizard.net_changes: This address changes every time the program starts. If you want a permanent link, you can set it up now or later in Settings.
wizard.net_channel_link: Channel link: paste it into the VRChat player
wizard.net_failed: Could not connect to the internet.
wizard.net_intro: The program connects the channel to the internet by itself, so the player in VRChat can open it. You do not have to install or type anything.
wizard.net_online: The channel is on the internet.
wizard.net_qr_alt: QR code of the request page
wizard.net_qr_hint: Viewers can scan this code with a phone to add a video.
wizard.net_retrying: Could not connect to the internet: the program keeps trying.
wizard.net_skip_hint: You can try again or skip this step: the channel then works only on this computer, and you can connect later in Settings, in the Internet section.
wizard.tools_failed: The tools could not be downloaded: {error}
wizard.tools_incomplete: Not all the tools were installed.
wizard.tools_intro: Downloading the programs the channel uses. Do not close the window.
wizard.welcome_intro: This program runs your own live video channel for VRChat: you add videos to the queue, and the player in your VRChat world shows them one after another.
wizard.welcome_setup: First the helper programs are downloaded once and the graphics card is checked. Then a few short steps with the main options: each already has a sensible default, every step can be skipped, and everything can be changed later in Settings.
wizard.advanced_pointer: More options are in {place}: loudness normalisation (off by default), smooth transitions, burned-in subtitles, the bitrate peak limit, alarms and the broadcast journal.
wizard.again_intro: The wizard shows your current settings. Change what you like; every step can be skipped.
wizard.extras_intro: Optional: send a picture from OBS to the channel, and show the video on air in your VRChat chatbox.
wizard.idle_qr: When nothing is playing, the slate shows the address of the request page and its QR code, as soon as the channel is on the internet.
wizard.later: You can change this later in {place}.
wizard.look_background: Your own background for the slates (an image, GIF or short video) can be added in {place}.
wizard.look_intro: What the stream shows when no video is playing, and while an audio file plays.
wizard.net_off: The connection to the internet is switched off.
wizard.remote_intro: Manage the channel from a phone or another computer by signing in with a password. The program's own window never needs it.
wizard.summary_intro: The channel is set up. Paste this link into the video player in VRChat.
wizard.summary_local: For now the channel works on this computer only. You can connect it to the internet in {place}.
wizard.test_add: Add a video: paste a link into the field of the Channel view.
wizard.test_preview: Check it on the Preview, the left screen of the Channel view.
wizard.test_vrchat: Paste the channel link into the video player in VRChat and play it.
wizard.ticker_intro: A band at the bottom of the picture: the title of the video, who added it and your messages.
wizard.tools_skip_hint: Without the tools the channel cannot play videos. You can download them later in {place}.
wizard.uploads_security: Files from viewers come from strangers and take space on this computer: switch this on only if you trust your viewers.
wizard.viewers_intro: Viewers add videos on the request page. Choose which links are accepted, whether you approve them first and how much one viewer may add.
wizard.viewers_lists_later: The lists of sites are edited in {place}.
screens.away: On air is in its own window
settings.channel.viewer_list_max_hint: Also the most entries read from a playlist (1–50).
settings.channel.viewer_list_max_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 50.
settings.channel.viewer_lists_hint: Viewers can paste several links at once (one per line) and playlists. Every video passes the same checks and limits as a single link.
settings.channel.uploads: Allow viewers to send small video and audio files
settings.channel.uploads_hint: The request page gets a file picker. Files follow the same nick, limit and approval rules as links and are deleted once they aired or were removed. Audio files air with the picture chosen under Audio files.
settings.channel.uploads_on: Viewers can send video and audio files.
settings.channel.uploads_off: Viewers can no longer send files. Files already in the queue stay.
settings.channel.uploads_invalid: Enter whole numbers: a file of 1–200 MB, a video or audio file of 1–120 min, all files 100–100000 MB.
settings.channel.uploads_tunnel_hint: Through the Cloudflare tunnel one request can carry at most 100 MB, so bigger files fail there; on a quick tunnel big files may also be slow. Some room is always kept free on the disk.
settings.channel.viewer_lists_off: Viewers add one link at a time.

viewer.links_hint.one: One link per line; playlists work too. Up to {count} video at once.
viewer.links_hint.other: One link per line; playlists work too. Up to {count} videos at once.

viewer.upload_label: Or send a video or audio file
viewer.upload_limits_audio: Up to {mb} MB; videos up to {limit}, audio up to {audio}.
viewer.upload_audio_note: Audio airs with a picture made from it.
trim.hint: Times like 1:30 or 1:02:30. Empty start: from the beginning; empty end: to the end.
trim.title: Start and end of the video
schedule.hint: Until then the stream shows a countdown when this video is next. A video on air is not cut off: if it runs longer, this one starts right after it.
schedule.title: Start at a set time

meter.label: Sound level

log.clip_audio: Video #{id} "{title}": audio only, transcoding with a picture ({picture}){resume}
log.audio_cover_failed: Video #{id} "{title}": the cover could not be read ({error}). Another picture is shown.
log.audio_picture_failed: Video #{id} "{title}": the picture for the audio could not be drawn ({error}). A simpler picture is shown.
settings.channel.audio_hint: Music and other sound without a picture (MP3, FLAC, Ogg, Opus, M4A, WAV files, SoundCloud links) airs with a picture made from it.
settings.channel.audio_visual_hint: Title and artist come from the file’s tags (or the site). Cover art: the file’s picture or the site’s thumbnail.
settings.channel.audio_visual_saved: Saved. It applies from the next audio file.
capture.open_title: Put a window, a screen, a camera or a microphone of this computer on air
capture.nothing: Nothing found. Connect the device and refresh.
capture.privacy: While the capture is on air, viewers see and hear what it captures. Only this window can start one; Stop in the title bar ends it.
capture.window_hint: The window is found by its title: if the title changes or the window closes, the capture ends.
capture.note_loopback: To air what this computer plays, turn on “Stereo Mix” in the Windows sound settings or install a virtual audio cable; it then shows up under Sound.
capture.note_wayland: Wayland: only screens and windows of X11 programs (XWayland) can be captured.
capture.note_no_display: No X display (DISPLAY): the screen cannot be captured here.
capture.note_no_windows_linux: Single windows cannot be captured on Linux; capture the screen or a part of it.
capture.note_unsupported: Capturing is not available on this system.
capture.indicator_title: A window, screen, camera or microphone of this computer is on air.
errors.capture_ended: The capture has ended. Add it again with Capture in the queue.
errors.capture_not_a_link: A capture of this computer cannot be added as a link.
errors.capture_invalid: The capture settings are not valid.
errors.capture_unknown_source: This window or device is not in the list any more. Refresh the list and pick it again.
log.capture_stopped: Capture stopped by the owner ({count} ended)
